title: Automotive-ENV: Benchmarking Multimodal Models in Automotive Cockpit Environments
abstract: arXiv:2509.21143v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal models have demonstrated strong capabilities in web, desktop, and mobile GUI environments, but their performance in automotive cockpit systems remains largely unexplored. In-vehicle GUIs introduce unique challenges beyond traditional GUI interaction, including vehicle-state reasoning, implicit intent understanding, and safety-critical decision making. To address this gap, we introduce Automotive-ENV, an interactive benchmark for evaluating multimodal models in automotive cockpit environments. Built on Android Automotive OS, Automotive-ENV combines cockpit-screen interaction with vehicle-state signals and deterministic state-based evaluation. The benchmark contains 420 carefully constructed tasks covering routine cockpit operation and safety-critical scenarios. Unlike prior GUI benchmarks that rely on action matching or LLM-based judging, Automotive-ENV evaluates model behavior through reproducible validators over UI

translated_title: Automotive-ENV：在汽车座舱环境中对多模态模型进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态模型已在网页、桌面和移动GUI环境中展现出强大的能力，但它们在汽车座舱系统中的性能在很大程度上仍未被探索。车载GUI引入了超越传统GUI交互的独特挑战，包括车辆状态推理、隐式意图理解和安全关键决策。为了填补这一空白，我们推出了Automotive-ENV，这是一个用于评估多模态模型在汽车座舱环境中表现的交互式基准测试。该基准基于Android Automotive OS构建，将座舱屏幕交互与车辆状态信号及基于状态的确定性评估相结合。该基准包含420个精心构建的任务，涵盖日常座舱操作和安全关键场景。与以往依赖动作匹配或基于大语言模型评判的GUI基准不同，Automotive-ENV通过对UI的可复现验证器来评估模型行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了Automotive-ENV，首个基于Android Automotive OS的交互式基准测试，通过420个涵盖日常座舱操作与安全关键场景的任务，结合车辆状态信号和可复现的状态验证器，系统评估多模态模型在汽车座舱环境中的能力。
